notes: create_task with repeat: "remind me every 2nd Friday to check the meeting agenda". repeat is {every?, unit, weekdays?, monthDay?, nthWeekday?, time, endTime?, timeZone, starts?, ends?}: every 1..1000 (default 1); unit "day"|"week"|"month"; weekdays (week only) a list of "mon".."sun" (default the weekday of starts); for month exactly one of monthDay (1..31, or -1 for the last day; a month without that day is skipped) or nthWeekday {n: 1..5 or -1 for last, weekday} (default monthDay = the day of starts); time and endTime "HH:MM" local wall time (an endTime at or before time is the next day); timeZone an IANA id such as "Europe/London"; starts "YYYY-MM-DD" local date (default today in timeZone); ends {"on": "YYYY-MM-DD"} or {"after": 1..1000}. The service fills the defaults at the call's time. The task becomes the current occurrence (the first one at or after now): it is due then and waits until that local day; completing or skipping it adds the next one, abandoning it ends the repeat. Clock changes keep the wall time. The owner's journal (and so the task) carries the normalised rule.
